about.heading: Electrical engineering, built into real hardware.
about.lead: I work hands-on across CAD, renewable energy, embedded systems, IoT and power electronics — using SolidWorks, MATLAB/Simulink, ESP8266/ESP32, Arduino and sensor-based automation to take ideas from a model to a working prototype.

projects.title: Hybrid Vertical-Axis Wind Turbine with Solar & IoT Monitoring
projects.description: A vertical-axis wind turbine combined with solar panels, with IoT monitoring of current, voltage, wind speed, RPM and solar output.

projects.title: HyperLocal Student Marketplace
projects.description: Students post what they need. Nearby shops reply with offers. The app lines them up side by side so the best price is obvious.

projects.title: DC-DC Converter Research Project
projects.description: Design and performance study of DC-DC converters, modelled and analysed in MATLAB/Simulink.

projects.title: Smart Irrigation Prototype Using ESP8266
projects.description: Sensor-based soil monitoring with automated pump control. Readings are uploaded to ThingSpeak for remote tracking.

projects.title: Poshan Setu 2.0
projects.description: Contributed to an anticipatory nutrition early-warning and action platform.

steps.title: Post a need
steps.text: A student describes the item, budget and pickup area — the request goes out to nearby shops.

steps.title: Shops offer
steps.text: Local shops see the request on their side of the app and reply with price and availability.

steps.title: Compare & pick
steps.text: Offers are ranked side by side, so the student picks the best deal and goes to collect it.
